_comment: Routine preset templates triggerable via POST /api/vortex/v1/routine/presets/{name} (see core/routines.py:start_preset). Each preset starts a guided routine and may optionally activate a Home Assistant scene first. Edit freely per-unit -- River Song can also list these via GET /api/vortex/v1/routine/presets.

steps.instruction: Good morning! Opening the blinds and bringing the lights up.
Here's today's weather and your first calendar event.
Locking the doors and turning off the lights.
Setting the thermostat to its overnight temperature.
Turning off lights and lowering the thermostat.
Locking the doors and arming the security system.
